# 4. complete case on rt_ms and biomarkers

    r, p = stats.pearsonr(df[b], df['rt_ms'])
    results[b] = {'r': r, 'p': p}
    pvals.append(p)
    rs.append(r)

m = len(pvals)

for i in range(m-2, -1, -1):
    adj_sorted[i] = min(adj_sorted[i], adj_sorted[i+1])
adj_sorted = np.minimum(adj_sorted, 1.0)
